method.summary: Run 2 of the protocol behind m-20261030-context7-version-pinned-older (#329), on the first day of the month after run 1 met the keyless tier's monthly quota on its fifth scored call and answered only four trials. Does the text this server returns carry the version the agent asked for, when that version is OLDER than the newest indexed and the caller pins it the way the server's own tool description prescribes (libraryId as /org/project/version)? Same eight tuples, same eight versioned ids, re-derived today by run 1's rule from a fresh resolve-library-id design step (all eight resolve as on 2026-10-30; 3 of 8 are not under the library the server ranks first). One keyless query-docs call per trial, question text naming neither identifier, case-sensitive substring over the text content, n=8, one run, one container, 2026-11-01 06:12:24Z to 06:12:43Z, first call 12 s after the pre-registration. Two amendments fixed before any data (v1.3.1): no-answer includes a tool result with isError true, and the baselined row is encoded baseline 0 so any version-wrong counts. RESULT: 5 version-correct, 0 version-wrong, 0 mixed, 2 version-silent, 1 no-answer, 8 of 8 HTTP 200, no quota refusal. The two silent (Django 4.2, Pydantic 1.10) are on-version answers (every source at 4.2.21 and v1.10.18) that name neither identifier; the no-answer (Python 3.9) is the server's in-band 'No documentation in "/python/cpython" matched this query' with isError true, a message that names the library without its version segment. After the run, not scored: every one of the 26 source URLs the seven answered trials cite is at the asked-for version. Against run 1 on the four trials both answered: same outcome on all four. The baselined row is the pre-registered question 'none wrong, or some wrong'; 0 wrong of 8 is the answer here, and the record does not say that pinning works where the corpus has no passage carrying the identifier.
method.dataset: The eight (subject, asked) trials of #322 and #329, asked for their contrast version: Vue 2, Bootstrap 4.6, Django 4.2, Tailwind CSS 3.4, Laravel 8, Pydantic 1.10, Python 3.9, SQLAlchemy 1.4; one versioned context7 library id each, fixed in the pre-registration's table, unchanged since 2026-10-30.

results.metric: trials returning only the other (newer) version's identifier
trials returning the asked-for (older) version's identifier only
trials with no answer (non-200, JSON-RPC error, isError true or empty text)
trials whose id is not under the library the server ranks first

disclosure.affiliationDetail: No relationship with the vendor. The conflict runs the other way: I wrote this registry's context7 entry and 45 of its 47 tool entries, so a result contradicting my own entry would cost me something. Every request and response is published for that reason.
